meta.name: ai-churn-prevention
meta.description: 流失预警诊断助手适合运营、产品、销售、software在用户提出“客户为什么要走”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成流失归因、挽回优先级、触达建议。

copy.tagline: 分析客户流失原因并生成挽回建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需快速定位客户流失原因并制定挽回策略
copy.tagline_en: Analyze churn reasons and generate retention suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly identify churn causes and craft win-back strategies

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，当你问“客户为什么要走”并提供转化目标、用户信息或页面链接等材料，Claude 会分析材料并输出流失原因、挽回优先级和触达建议。
howto.when: 当你提出“客户为什么要走”这类问题，需要快速拆解流失原因并形成可执行结果时触发。

say.text: 分析这批流失客户的原因，给出挽回优先级。
say.note: Claude 会输出流失归因和挽回建议。

say.text: 根据这个注册页链接，诊断用户流失点。
say.note: Claude 会结合页面内容分析流失原因。

howto.what_en: When you ask 'why customers are leaving' and provide materials like conversion goals, user info, or page links, Claude analyzes them and outputs churn attribution, recovery priority, and outreach suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions like 'why customers are leaving' and need to quickly break down churn causes into actionable results.

say_en.text: Analyze the reasons for these churned customers and give recovery priority.
say_en.note: Claude will output churn attribution and recovery suggestions.

say_en.text: Diagnose user churn points based on this landing page link.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze churn causes using the page content.
